scope: B1 strong generic longitudinal summary; B2 insight-style, not official PHIA; B3 five retrieval queries; B4 deterministic raw statistical facts. No Personal Evidence method implemented.
protocol_amendments: Human gold replaced by requested independent-context LLM judges and adjudicator, with explicit provisional status.
Evidence-vs-summary primary comparison cannot be executed because this phase intentionally excludes Evidence; all baseline comparisons diagnose whether further research is warranted.
B3 uses five queries and fixed within-retriever RRF. This is the requested strong multiquery baseline and has five retrieval operations versus one for B1/B2/B4; report this resource difference.
All representation prompts and knowledge text use English; no PHIA claim.
Qwen3.8-max uses the user-confirmed Alibaba Cloud endpoint. No Codex model calls or outputs are part of this execution version. The prior aborted model run is archived separately.
Two independent fresh-context Qwen judges and a third fresh-context Qwen adjudicator share weights; they are not independent model families. Shared-family bias is a validity limitation.
LLM model identifier fixed but provider weights are not an immutable open snapshot; HTTP request IDs, returned model names and usage logs retained.

API max_tokens=16384 and temperature=0 are fixed. 256-token final representation text budget is separately enforced with cl100k_base; record pre-enforcement tokens and truncation. No unverified provider seed support is assumed.
